proposal.reason: Trial 1 shows a strong linear logistic baseline at 0.92318 accuracy on the primary split. The extra_trees route is untried, and a 300-tree ensemble with min_samples_leaf=1 is a reasonable first nonlinear probe for tabular shape features that may contain interactions not captured by logistic regression.

proposal.hypothesis: An untried extra-trees ensemble may capture nonlinear feature interactions among the shape descriptors and improve accuracy over the linear logistic baseline on the same primary split.
proposal.uncertainty: Unknown whether extra trees will beat the strong logistic baseline; min_samples_leaf=1 may overfit, and only primary-split evidence is available.
